name: Session State
description: Hooks + scripts that maintain CONTEXT_STATE.md, MEMORY.md, and compact-resume state in each project's .claude/ directory. No process — a collection of shell scripts registered with Claude Code's hook system.

requirements._windows_note: Every hook ships as a bash script plus a PowerShell sibling (.ps1). On Windows the installer registers the .ps1 siblings (templates/settings.json.windows.template runs them with powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File), so no WSL2 is needed; Linux and macOS run the .sh scripts.

install._note: Not executed. A bundled module is never installed by the launcher: its manifest is embedded in the launcher and hub binaries, and only its settings and secrets are read (the hub's /env and catalog). The hooks and scripts reach EVERY project through the orchestrator's bundle install/update (install.py --add-project, the launcher's Update bundle, python -m vco_lib.project_init install-bundle), which copies templates/hooks/ and templates/scripts/ into the project's .claude/ and registers the hooks in .claude/settings.json from templates/settings.json.linux.template or templates/settings.json.windows.template — not per module enable.

settings.prompt: Warn if CONTEXT_STATE.md exceeds N lines
settings.description: The context-size-check SessionStart hook alerts at N lines and gives a notice from 60% of N. Read by the hook as $CONTEXT_STATE_MAX_LINES, else through the vct-hub /env (this setting), else 500.

settings.prompt: Warn if MEMORY.md exceeds N lines
settings.description: The context-size-check SessionStart hook warns when Claude Code's auto-memory MEMORY.md for this project reaches N lines (Claude Code loads only its first 200). Same resolution as CONTEXT_STATE_MAX_LINES; default 200.

runtime._note: No process and no command. The hooks run under Claude Code's hook system. Nothing would read a command here: the launcher starts only container and service runtimes (module_supervisor, lifecycle_api) and never installs or starts a bundled module, and there is no health-check action for one. The command this block used to name (a health-check.sh script, behind a 'Run health check' button) never shipped, so none is declared.

_mcp_note: Not an MCP — hook scripts run under Claude Code's hook system, not the MCP protocol.
